author: brian_armstrong
text:
We’ve set the standard with Coinbase Tokenized Stocks.

No synthetics or debt instruments, real fully-backed securities, redeemable for the underlying shares, with dividends integrated, and voting rights coming soon.

That means access for global investors and institutions to the $70T+ US stock market built on a solid foundation.
